title: Facility Operations: Re-Verification Charge on Vehicle Changes after Collections Notices, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Operations rule.** A re-verification charge is added to the fee for a change of vehicle on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: **$10.00** where a notice of intent to tow was sent on the agreement in the last 2 months; **$5.00** where none was but a gate lockout notice was sent in that time; nothing otherwise.

A window of the last 2 months covers entries dated less than 2 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month. A notice is placed in the window by its notice date.

The charge is added after the swap fee level has been multiplied by anything it is multiplied by; the fee is rounded to the cent at the end.

| Notices on the agreement in the last 2 months | Charge added |
|---|---|
| A notice of intent to tow (whether or not a gate lockout notice was also sent) | $10.00 |
| A gate lockout notice only | $5.00 |
| Neither | nothing |

Hypothetical cases (handling date 18 September): a gate lockout notice dated 25 July — inside the window, $5.00; a notice of intent to tow dated 18 July — exactly 2 whole months before, outside the window.
